name.en: Thingyan — A New Year in Water

teaser.zh: 節日裡的水不只是熱鬧，也象徵告別舊的一年，迎接新的開始。
teaser.en: The water is joyful, but it also speaks of cleansing, renewal and community.
teaser.my: သင်္ကြန်သည် မြန်မာ့နှစ်သစ်ကူးပွဲတော်ဖြစ်ပြီး ရေကစားခြင်းနှင့် ကောင်းမှုကုသိုလ်ပြုခြင်းများ ပါဝင်သည်။

story.zh: 四月的城市與城鎮，音樂、歡笑與潑水帶來新年的氣氛。但 Thingyan 並不只有水花：有人回家探親，有人向長輩致敬，也有人布施、禪修，或參與社區活動。
story.en: In mid-April, music and water fill streets and gathering places. Yet Thingyan is more than the splash: many people return home, honor elders, share food, give to charity, or take time for reflection.

context.zh: Atā Thingyan 是緬甸傳統新年節慶，通常在四月中旬舉行。潑水象徵洗去舊年的不順與迎接更新。各社群慶祝方式有所不同。UNESCO 於 2024 年將它列入人類非物質文化遺產代表作名錄。
context.en: Atā Thingyan is Myanmar's traditional New Year festival, usually celebrated in mid-April. Water symbolizes cleansing and a fresh beginning. Customs differ across communities. UNESCO inscribed the festival on the Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity in 2024.

moments.zh: 對長輩表達敬意，也是常見的新年傳統之一。
moments.en: Paying respect to elders is part of the festival for many families.

moments.zh: 慈善與布施讓節慶不只是一場狂歡。
moments.en: Giving and community care share the stage with celebration.

moments.zh: 相似的潑水節在東南亞其他國家也有，但各地意義與習俗不完全相同。
moments.en: Neighboring countries have related water festivals, each with distinctive practices.

note.zh: 水花落下之後，迎接的是一個新的開始。
note.en: Beyond the splash is the promise of beginning again.
